jobs.occupation: Master Thesis "Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling" - JOB ID: 269596
jobs.description:
1 Master Thesis "Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling" - JOB ID: 269596  * Differentiable ray-tracing frameworks such as Sionna RT have become powerful tools for wireless channel modeling. This master's thesis advances differentiable ray tracing for realistic large-scale radio propagation, either by integrating atmospheric refraction models or by learning electromagnetic environment properties directly from channel measurements.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will implement and evaluate atmospheric refraction models in the differentiable ray-tracing framework Sionna RT.
 * You will implement and evaluate differentiable algorithms for estimating electromagnetic material properties from real-world channel measurements.
 * You will learn how to develop and validate simulation workflows for large-scale radio propagation, combining physics-based propagation models with discrete ray tracing, low-complexity ray-shooting, and gradient-based optimisation techniques.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with modern wireless communication simulation frameworks, electromagnetic wave propagation, physics-based and inverse modeling, and AI-enabled optimisation methods.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless communications and contribute to the development of next-generation ray-tracing methods for realistic large-scale propagation prediction.

Your qualifications:

 * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.
 * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) atmospheric refraction modelling for ray tracing or (ii) learning environment properties using differentiable ray tracing. Candidates should explain in their cover letter how their background matches one of these areas and demonstrate relevant expertise.
 * You have solid programming skills in Python; experience with object-oriented software development is an advantage.
 * You have a basic understanding of electromagnetics, wave propagation, wireless communications, or computer graphics.
 * Knowledge of ray tracing, geometric optics, optimisation methods, or machine learning is beneficial but not required.
 * Experience with scientific computing frameworks (e.g., NumPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Sionna) is a plus.
 * You enjoy developing algorithms and solving challenging scientific and engineering problems.
 * You are able to work independently while collaborating effectively in an interdisciplinary research team.
 * English language skills commensurate with the role

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: as soon as possible - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date
 * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.

jobs.description: From DEV bench to center stage -- build the future of streaming.   At BIG BLUE MARBLE, we enable easy access to broadcast content in Austria while driving innovation and customer service in media delivery. Our mission is to actively shape the digital future of TV and radio. By continuously optimizing the media experience for our customers, we provide innovative streaming solutions while pursuing sustainable practices for a climate-friendly broadcasting landscape. To lead our Innovation & Research LAB -- publicly known as BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (labs.bigbluemarble.com) -- at ORS comm GmbH & Co KG, we are looking for a: Program Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs, all genders Are you a developer at heart who's ready for the next chapter -- one where you spend less time in the IDE and more time shaping which technologies your company bets on next? Do you want to turn prototypes into real business impact, represent your company on international stages, and build the innovation ecosystem of a streaming platform from the ground up? If you have a technical background and the ambition to grow into a coordinating, outward-facing leadership role, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs is where you belong. Your responsibilities:   Innovation  Scouting Innovation is not an end in itself for us. We want to understand early which technologies will shape the streaming world of tomorrow -- and which of them are actually relevant for our platform and our customers. You scout new technologies, solutions, start-ups, and trends in the streaming and media-tech space. You analyze technological developments and assess their relevance and potential applications for our products. You attend industry conferences, trade fairs, and events at home and abroad, build a relevant network, and bring fresh impulses into the company. You work closely with our Innovation Management and Professional Services team to move promising technologies from first assessment through to potential Proofs of Concept. You translate your findings into clear, digestible formats and share your knowledge internally and externally -- through technical blog posts, presentations, or trend and technology analyses. AI and automation are a permanent part of your technology radar -- always with an eye on concrete use cases in the streaming and platform environment. Innovation Lab & Proof of Concept Program You lead the operational activities of BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs and coordinate its day-to-day innovation processes. You organize and facilitate our bi-weekly Proof of Concept (PoC) sprints together with our Full Stack Development team. Together with Product Management, you evaluate ideas entering the innovation funnel, prioritize opportunities, and initiate new PoCs. You coordinate PoCs from idea validation to successful completion, ensuring transparency, alignment, and effective collaboration across technical and business teams. You make sure PoC outcomes are properly documented and turned into reusable knowledge, technical assets, or follow-up initiatives. You continuously improve our Lab processes, fostering an agile, execution-oriented innovation culture. Innovation Ecosystem & Strategic Partnerships You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs nationally and internationally within the innovation ecosystem -- universities, research institutions, public organizations, start-ups, and technology partners. You act as a key contact for strategic collaborations and help identify opportunities for joint innovation and research initiatives. You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE at conferences, workshops, exhibitions, and industry events, expanding our professional network and visibility. You contribute to strategic initiatives across the organization, supporting new partnerships and innovation opportunities. Knowledge Transfer & Innovation Communication You ensure innovation outcomes are communicated effectively, internally and externally. You support the creation of technical blogs, conference papers, exhibition contributions, presentations, and other dissemination formats. Equivalent professional experience is welcome in place of a formal degree. A genuine wish to change direction: you're ready to trade day-to-day coding for coordinating people, representing the company externally, and shaping innovation strategy. Prior exposure to project or product coordination is a plus, not a requirement. Streaming and broadcast media know-how is very welcome -- but if you bring strong technical fundamentals, we're confident you can build this knowledge quickly on the job. You're comfortable presenting, networking, and representing BIG BLUE MARBLE confidently in front of external audiences -- at conferences, workshops, and partner meetings. You enjoy structuring ambiguous, early-stage ideas, coordinating people across disciplines, and turning promising concepts into tangible outcomes. Travel This position includes occasional national and international business travel, with an expected travel commitment of up to four weeks per year, primarily for conferences, trade fairs, workshops, partner meetings, and industry events. *For legal reasons, we are required to state the minimum salary as per the collective agreement.
